## Eagle Auto Tagger 2.2.2

### New Model

- Adds Llama JoyCaption Beta One 8B support through the local llamafile backend.
- The built-in downloader provides the fast, recommended Q4_K_M GGUF main model and its required F16 vision projection model.

### Installation

- Windows x64: `auto-tagger-eagle-plugin-v2.2.2-win-x64.eagleplugin`
- macOS ARM64: `auto-tagger-eagle-plugin-v2.2.2-mac-arm64.eagleplugin`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bukkumaaku/auto-tagger-eagle-plugin/compare/v2.2.1...v2.2.2
